notes.title: Update #2 - Major Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
Hey,

Over the past months we fixed all major bugs reported by you. We tried our best to fix them as soon as possible but as you know it's a tough job for a small indie team to do.
Thanks for your feedback and patience!

Cheers,
Headless Wizard

notes.title: Update #1 - Night Hunters
notes.content:
Dear night hunters, your favorite achievement (Night Hunter : Complete one level between 12:00 AM and 06:00 AM) had a little problem but it's fixed and ready to achieve now!

Thanks a lot for your feedback!
